title: Lamentations Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on Lamentations 1: the city that sits solitary, her lost comforters, and the complaint brought to Yahweh.

questions.text: How does the chapter open, describing the city that was full of people?
questions.explanation: The city sits solitary, has become as a widow, and she who was a princess among the provinces has become a slave.

answers.text: She is full of people and rejoicing as before
She sits solitary, like a widow, a princess who has become a slave
She is being rebuilt by the nations around her
She is honored as the greatest among the nations

questions.text: What is said about her lovers and her friends?
questions.explanation: Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her, and all her friends have dealt treacherously with her and become her enemies.

answers.text: Her friends have come from far to help her
Her lovers have brought her gifts and comfort
Her friends weep together with her in the night
None of her lovers comforts her, and her friends are her enemies

questions.text: Why has Judah gone into captivity?
questions.explanation: Judah has gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude, and she finds no rest among the nations.

answers.text: Because of affliction and because of great servitude
Because the rain had failed in the land
Because of the sword of the king of Egypt
Because her king had fled away by night

questions.text: Why do the roads to Zion mourn?
questions.explanation: The roads to Zion mourn because no one comes to the solemn assembly; all her gates are desolate and her priests sigh.

answers.text: Because the rain has washed them away
Because the enemy camps on them
Because no one comes to the solemn assembly
Because they have been closed by the king

questions.text: What have the princes of the daughter of Zion become like?
questions.explanation: Her princes have become like deer that find no pasture, and they have gone without strength before the pursuer.

answers.text: Lions without prey
Deer that find no pasture
Sheep led to the slaughter
Eagles in the clefts of the rock

questions.text: What has the adversary spread out his hand on?
questions.explanation: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things, and the nations have entered into her sanctuary.

answers.text: The crown of her king
The fields outside the city
The books of her prophets
All her pleasant things

questions.text: What do all her people do in verse 11?
questions.explanation: All her people sigh and seek bread, and they have given their pleasant things for food to refresh their soul.

answers.text: They sing in the streets
They gather for battle
They sigh and seek bread
They flee to Egypt

questions.text: Whom has the Lord trodden as in a wine press?
questions.explanation: The Lord has trodden the virgin daughter of Judah as in a wine press, and has called a solemn assembly against her to crush her young men.

answers.text: The virgin daughter of Judah
The kings of the nations
The enemies of Zion
The priests of the city

questions.text: In verse 18, what does the speaker say about Yahweh and about herself?
questions.explanation: She says that Yahweh is righteous, for she has rebelled against his commandment.

answers.text: Yahweh is unjust, and she has kept his law
Yahweh is righteous, and she has rebelled against his commandment
Yahweh has forgotten her, though she is innocent
Yahweh is silent, and she does not know her sin

questions.text: What does the speaker ask at the end concerning her enemies?
questions.explanation: She asks that all their wickedness come before Yahweh, and that he do to them as he has done to her for all her transgressions.

answers.text: That they be comforted in their trouble
That they be given the city to rebuild
That they become her friends again
That Yahweh do to them as he has done to her
